out.rationale: Compare CID knowability conditioned on decision-node parents with AISFA's observation-factorization result; check domain and quantifier differences.
out.scope: Definition 23 is a probabilistic condition in a CID: Y must take a unique value with conditional probability 1 given each value of Pa_D (the parents of D) that has positive probability. The AISFA Lean Knowable is declared over types {Ω : Sort u} {I : Sort v} {Y : Sort w}, with an observation map such as Ω → I in place of the parents of D, and its obstruction is a colliding pair (knowable_iff_no_collision); no probability measure appears in its recorded declaration lines. The Lean declarations are recorded only as lexical matches with no review status, and no correspondence between the two notions has been checked.

text: For a CID M with variables V, Y ∈ V is knowable at D ∈ V if for every value pa_D of Pa_D such that Pr_M(Pa_D = pa_D) > 0, there is a unique value y_paD ∈ dom(Y) such that Pr_M(Y = y_paD | Pa_D = pa_D) = 1.
title: Definition 23: knowability
